patches.note: MON runtime + the desktop hook: the Monuments toolbar button (state sn, aria-pressed from group AX) now drives GTMON.

the legacy app starts with the Monuments state TRUE (the toolbar button looked pressed at load while nothing was drawn, and the first click turned it off); now the button is off at load, matching the layer: aria-pressed is true exactly when the markers are on screen.

gives the card its "Open in Walkthrough list" action the same opener as the toolbar button (Ut(!0)), and the runtime the setter of the button state ($n): the state outlives the desktop layout (the shell stays mounted while the phone layout shows), so a layer switched off on the phone must be able to switch the button off too.
phone component: one more prop (the Walkthrough opener) and the layer state for the Tools tile; matches the signature with or without group C's extra props.
the phone map joins the runtime when it has loaded (the runtime adds its layers a microtask later, after the app's own layers).
restores the phone Tools "Monuments" tile (aria-pressed, toggles the layer); R1a had a dead tile here, R1b/R1c had none.
a Tools tile may carry gtMon: it then shows the layer state (gold border, aria-pressed).
toolbar of a desktop window narrower than 1000 px: the Virtual Walkthrough button no longer lies on top of the Monuments button (pre-existing in every train: the rule it replaces is group AX's).
